data.title: Fee quotes lower than the fee charged
data.symptom: The fee shown to customers before a transfer is sometimes one cent lower than the fee they are charged.
data.alert: Support tickets: 38 customers this week say the fee quoted before sending was lower than the fee on their statement. Every ticket is for a transfer under $50.

remediation.rootCause: The quote endpoint in bank_service/api.py used ties-to-even rounding, while transfers used half-up rounding.
remediation.patchSummary: Quotes now use the shared transfer_fee_cents function; transfer charging remains unchanged.

testsRun.summary: Before fix: reproduced the mismatch, quoted 2 cents versus charged 3 cents.

remediation.humanSummary: Fee quotes now use the same rounding calculation as transfer charges. The incident test and all 23 tests pass, with only bank_service/api.py changed.
